name: Kravchenko Georgy
aboutMe_text: Greetings! My name is Georgy Kravchenko. I have been developing websites for the past year and am looking to start my career as a Junior Frontend Developer with the goal of becoming a Fullstack developer in the future. I am a student majoring in Software Developer. I speak English at B1 level and Czech at A1 level. At previous workplaces, I learned to communicate effectively with colleagues and quickly adapt to a new team.
